questions.explanation: Option (A) is correct: A-(P); B-(Q); C-(R); D-(S).

questions.question: Human male urethra acts as passage for:
Which of the following depicts the correct pathway of transport of sperms?
options: Rete testis Epididymis Efferent ductules Vas deferens
Rete testis Vas deferens Efferent ductules Epididymis
Efferent ductules Rete testis Vas deferens Epididymis
Rete testis Efferent ductules Epididymis Vas deferens
questions.explanation: Option (D) is correct: Rete testis Efferent ductules Epididymis Vas deferens.

questions.question: Testes descend into scrotum in mammals for
Choose the incorrect statement w.r.t. primary sex organ in males.
options: They have immunocompetent cells in their interstitium.
They are lined by meiotically dividing sertoli cells and germ cells.
They have leydig cells that secrete androgens.
questions.explanation: Option (C) is correct: They are lined by meiotically dividing sertoli cells and germ cells..

questions.question: Read the following statements and find out the incorrect statements. 1. Each testicular lobule contains one to three highly coiled seminiferous tubules in which sperm are produced. 2. Each seminiferous tubule is lined on its inside by two types of cells called Leydig cells and Sertoli cells. 3. The region outside the seminiferous tubules called interstitial space, contains small blood vessels and male germ cells (spermatogonia) which lead to sperm formation. 4. In testis immunologically compenent cells are also present. 5. The seminiferous tubules of the testis open into the rete testis through vasa efferentia. → → → → → → → → → → → →
